warnings.message: This scorer or series has not completed all validation and production gates.
The eligible observation count is below the approved release threshold.
Clustering or weighting reduces the effective sample below the approved threshold.
The approved historical baseline does not have sufficient eligible coverage.
One or more required sources did not complete collection for this period.
The source-family composition changed beyond the approved comparison tolerance.
Entity, topic, genre, occupation, jurisdiction, or field coverage changed beyond tolerance.
The requested comparison has residual topic, event, template, or genre confounding.
A required benchmark or safety slice regressed below its frozen threshold.
Feature or label extraction changed beyond the approved drift tolerance.
One or more inputs, transformations, or versions cannot be reconstructed.
Source rights or retention state prohibit this calculation or publication.
The approved confidence calculation could not be completed.
Relative change is null because the approved baseline value is zero.
A major scorer version starts a separate series unless an approved bridge permits comparison.
The result is intentionally withheld because one or more required gates failed.
